metaDescription: Order custom 16 oz desk mugs in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for offices, with ample capacity for coffee or tea. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Custom 16 oz desk mugs offer the perfect balance of capacity and comfort for everyday office use. Larger than standard 11 oz mugs, they hold a generous serving of coffee, tea, or soup without being overly bulky. Options like the 16 oz Apache Mug or Navajo Mug provide ample surface area for full-color imprinting, making your logo stand out during morning meetings or breakroom conversations. Bulk orders ensure consistent branding across your team or client gifts.
heroAltText: Custom 16 oz desk mugs with full-color logo imprint, perfect for office branding and promotional gifts.
